known_limitations: The registry is intentionally read-only and derives health state only from service catalog metadata, dependency matrix metadata, validation state, and authoritative source-link availability.
It does not probe live services, replace monitoring systems, or fabricate runtime telemetry.
Dependency health is computed only for explicit dependencies resolved by the Service Dependency Matrix.
Runtime JSON output is generated locally at runtime/services/service_health_registry.json and is not committed when runtime outputs are ignored by repository policy.
pull_request_url is null until the PR is created.
summary: Implemented a read-only Estate Service Health Registry aggregating catalog and dependency matrix data into health, availability, validation, dependency-health, last-known update, and authoritative source-link views for Mission Control, the Operations Center, and Alfred. Added CLI access, generated Markdown output, source-link integrity checks, graceful unavailable-source handling, and tests for healthy, degraded, unavailable, unknown, and missing-metadata states.
